correctness.rationale: A Poisson-reset renewal coupling gives the unique stationary law. Solving the exact infinite-chain empty-interval recurrence, including the coincident-root limit, yields symmetric E_n and exact density and nearest-neighbor pair probabilities. Quadratic root analysis proves the full closed/open realizability wedge and precise preimage multiplicity; the local generator yields m=2D+r(1-p). At fixed u, the explicit vacancy parameter q(lambda) and the rate factor decrease strictly as lambda increases, proving global (u,m) identification and full feasibility. The packaged check.py verifies 300 parameter pairs, independent finite-block recurrence solves, and collision and monotonicity cases; numerical checks do not serve as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The inverse problem is physically motivated by distinct reset concentration and reset clock rate in an interacting coagulating lattice gas. Arbitrarily complete stationary contiguous-empty-run observations can have a two-point parameter fiber. A single well-defined right derivative of local occupancy correlation breaks the ambiguity, and the theorem gives sharp feasibility inequalities and a constructive unique inverse. This addresses structural observability rather than a routine tabulation or small perturbative improvement.
